title: OTAS Asset Core Descriptor
description: The COMMON envelope: enough for a third party to recognize two tokenizations as the same underlying instrument. Contents beyond this are semi-common (lifecycle/terms) or issuer-defined (typed extensions). Aligned to existing financial vocabularies (ISO 20022 / FIX / FpML) rather than inventing parallel ones.

settlement_asset_tier.description: Credit tier is explicit core metadata, not buried in documentation

terms.description: Semi-common layer: coupon schedule / day-count / maturity (debt); NAV source / distribution (funds); device+oracle (IoT-linked)

extensions.description: Issuer-defined, typed; must not break common parsers
